### LOW: New add\-on local IPC/mailbox control channel is not covered by the threat model
[provider\-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Addon/AddonPeerPolicy\.swift:57](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/e164315dc41b5c0b0bbbef0cc47e77f1c13f2608/provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Addon/AddonPeerPolicy.swift#L57) · TB-003

This PR adds a local control surface that can close serving admission, cancel in\-flight inference after 120s, and unload every model\. Callers are code\-signature\-authenticated sockets \(AddonPeerPolicy\.authenticate\) and the operator mailbox \(handleAddonControl\)\. No TB/T entry covers this boundary: socket location and permissions, per\-connection versus per\-request authentication, lease bounds, or the rule that an expired lease is kept while the machine lock is held \(ProviderLoop\+AddonHold\.swift:322\-334, 142\-146\)\. The lock appears to be observed through a plain file, so any same\-UID process that takes it could keep the provider held indefinitely\. The same\-UID user is already the operator \(ADV\-001\), so this is an availability and documentation gap rather than a confidentiality regression\. Fix: add a TB entry and threat for the add\-on hold, recording the peer policy, lease clamps, machine\-lock semantics and fail\-open on an unreadable hold record \(ProviderLoop\+AddonHold\.swift:366\-368\)\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: New add\-on hold IPC surface cites an undefined threat\-model boundary \(TB\-012\)
[docs/reference/addon\-hold\-ipc\.md:94](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/e164315dc41b5c0b0bbbef0cc47e77f1c13f2608/docs/reference/addon-hold-ipc.md#L94) · TB-002, TB-003

docs/reference/addon\-hold\-ipc\.md documents a new local AF\_UNIX \`hold\.v1\` control surface \(\~/\.darkbloom/runtime/addon\.sock\)\. Over it, a code\-signed add\-on can make the provider drain or hold serving capacity, and an expired lease is kept while the add\-on holds ownership\.lock\. The doc points readers to threat\-model \`TB\-012\` \(line 96\), but the base canonical model defines boundaries only through TB\-011\. No asset, threat or mitigation covers this boundary\. Nothing in the model covers the same\-user peer\-token and code\-requirement check, the DEBUG\-only \`DARKBLOOM\_ADDON\_DEV\_IDENTITY\` acceptance, the \`DARKBLOOM\_ADDON\_SOCKET\` path override, or the indefinite availability hold through ownership\.lock\. The new \`darkbloom addon\` lifecycle\-mailbox commands in cli\-reference\.md are also unmodeled\. Trigger: a reviewer relies on TB\-012 to evaluate this surface, but no TB\-012 exists\. Impact: provider availability and drain controls stay unreviewed against TB\-003 and TB\-002\. The model also does not record that busy fields reported to the coordinator are self\-reported\. Fix: add TB\-012 and its threats to docs/threat\-model\.yaml\. The new entries should record that the socket is not a boundary against the same user\. They should state whether release builds honor DARKBLOOM\_ADDON\_SOCKET\. They should also bound how long a hold can persist\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-opus\-5\.5
